title: Add destination_v18: raise the speed level only when every walk in the 30 updates passes the evaluator's checks
summary: destination_v18 is destination_v17 that also needs every walk finished in the 30-update window to pass the evaluator's moving checks: mean planar error within a quarter of the commanded speed (at least 0.025 m/s), mean yaw-rate error within 0.06 rad/s, tilt RMS within 5 degrees, vertical velocity RMS within 0.04 m/s, torque demand above 1.6 Nm in at most 0.5% of joint-controls, no joint above the 50.3 rad/s speed limit and no fall, each over the walk after its first 100 controls. Replaying the destination_v17 update-500 and destination_v15 update-1750 surrogate traces through these sums gives the evaluator's values and verdicts on all 14 walks. At update 500, destination_v17 held 0.125 m/s within 6 mm of the ghost in seven directions but failed the planar-error check in all eight.
next: Train destination_v18 from the v9 checkpoint on the surrogate and test it against v9 at 0.05 to 0.15 m/s.
